implementation.rejection: Snapshot actual uint16 scenario selector. Outgoing still installs1082 before native cast for original instance selection. implementation.retry: UpdateAI subtracts diff safely, emits at most one due attempt per update, clears timer before reentering the same guarded final waypoint method. Re-resolve current summoner/vehicle and alive/active/not-rewarded quest, not a stale Player pointer. Missing/dismounted/wrong-map/dead/abandoned/rewarded state cancels the queued attempt; no forced reboard or automatic resumption after revoked eligibility. A legitimate fresh boarding/final waypoint can retry. Failures remain diagnosed each attempt while owner is eligible and the AI lives; no diagnostic suppression or arbitrary success timeout.
implementation.accepted: Only native SPELL_CAST_OK latches accepted and clears in-progress before the original500ms despawn. Repeated/native/nested callbacks, boarding and ordinary Reset cannot issue another accepted endpoint request on that AI. OK is admission, not a promise of three delivered effects, successful destination teleport, client loading or saved quest credit.
